name: Chris Morillo
strengths: Morillo triggers downhill off backfield keys and presses run fits without wasted steps.
Morillo chases sideline to sideline with clean pursuit angles and still arrives with balance.
Morillo finishes through contact — wraps and drives instead of arm-tackling in the box.
weaknesses: Morillo still adding mass at 6-2 / 198 and needs cleaner block-shed plus more proven coverage drops for every-down LB.
comparison: Morillo comps to Ernest Jones — 6-2 compact LB mold; triggers downhill, finishes in space, and chases with range before packing full MIKE mass.
projection: Morillo projects as a Year 2 SEC rotation LB (special teams Year 1). Ceiling: every-down WILL/MIKE — the compact Florida-bred second-level piece who can chase, finish, and grow into the box.
schemeFit: Morillo fits a Tony White second-level LB who can run, finish, and steal nickel/edge snaps while adding mass.
staffNotes: Vault film desk re-verified 2026-08-22 from Hudson Hudl. Comp size-matched to Ernest Jones (6-2). Confirm with Charles before FutureCast card copy.
insiderNotes: Morillo is a compact 6-2 Hudson ATH/LB who triggers downhill, finishes with a wrap, and still has range when flow stretches. Florida offered under Tony White with a June 15 UOV; in-state process live vs FSU visit heat and USF. Wins with instincts, chase, and finishing.
recruitingStory: Chris Morillo is a 2028 Hudson (FL) ATH · 4-star · Natl #288 · ATH #15 · FL #38 · 6-2 / 198. Uncommitted. Florida offered (Tony White) with 1 UOV 2026-06-15; UF sits near the front of On3 RPM. FSU holds heavy visit volume (4 UOVs); USF also live.
angle: Hudson LB tape: trigger + finish + chase range. In-state Florida process under Tony White.
